'''2008 Worlds Team Jesse Reynolds DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jesse Reynolds]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Sheet title Stutterific. Team Half naked.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jesse Reynolds]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor Operations]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
